spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
:
 The Eighteen
 Governing States of Divine
 Order

---


**
¶1.
** Eighteen ruling
 states of divine order exist and are appointed
 for
 all who hold
 spiritual authority,
 and
 they are established across
 eighteen distinct degrees of the mind
. Nine
 of these
 are
 arranged
 in the celestial degrees beyond the natural
 mind, yet
 they extend
 their governance
 into every region where
 falsity and evil have wr
ought corruption.

**¶2
.** The first and
 in
most governing state is that
 of the Divine
 Love itself, the God
 of all
 Divine
 Truth,
 the supreme
 ruling Truth
 over
 every
 celestial state —
 the One
 who is
,
 who
 subs
ists in
 His
 own infinite
 essence alone
, apart
 from all that
 proceeds from Him
. This is the first governing state,
 and
 it surpasses every
 other,
 because
 it is the Divine itself before
 any
 eman
ation.


**¶3.** The
 second governing state belongs
 to the Divine
 Truth proceeding from Divine Love, which
 gives spiritual life. She
 is the origin of every
 truth that has descended into the natural mind
 and
 into
 the states
 of the
 world
 below
.

**¶4.**
 The third governing state is prepared
 for the first
 celestial wisdom
.
 This
 is the wisdom
 that hum
iliated and
 overcame the entire
 primal opposition of evil
 —
 the original 
enmity that had
 established
 itself throughout
 the regions of fals
ity and
 spiritual
 ignor
ance.

**¶5.
** The fourth governing state belongs
 to the inmost affection cher
ished by
 all wisdoms —
 the love that is held precious
 within the celestial states themselves,
 honored
 among
 every
 ex
alted degree
 of the mind.

**¶
6.** The fifth governing state belongs
 to the Divine
 power
 that establishes spiritual
 order —
 the great architect
 who formed
 a new regener
ate state
 of the mind, a new degree of
 interior
 life
;
 both
 as
 a
 dwelling
 for
 the governing
 loves
 gr
ounded in wisdom, and as a contain
ment and
 restra
int upon
 evil
 and
 its
 powers,
 so
 that they
 cannot
 flow
 freely into the higher
 degrees.

**¶7.
** The sixth governing state belongs
 to the Divine proceeding as active spiritual
 life — the mighty
 power
 that raised the first celestial wisdom up
 out
 of the region
 of falsity where it had descended
 and
 been
 submerged;
 and
 that
 also
 set in order and arranged
 the natural mind,
 both for the
 purification of every
 element
 of wisdom held
 captive within
 it, and for the binding
 and
 restra
int
 of the powers of opposition.

**
¶8.** The seventh governing
 state belongs to the Divine mediation active
 within
 the sphere of spiritual engagement —
 the ruling
 truth within
 the region where spiritual conflict
 occurs,
 and
 the source of all interior counsel
 and perception.

**¶9
.** The eighth governing state belongs to
 the
 Divine Wisdom that illuminates —
 the power
 that releases
 and
 re
deems every interior life from captivity
 to falsity and evil.

**
¶10.** The ninth governing
 state is
 that
 of the Divine Intelligence itself
, toward
 whom
 all communities of faith shall
 be
 gathered, and to
 whom every element
 of spiritual life that
 has been separated and
 pur
ified from the corruptions of the natural
 mind shall return
.

**¶11.**
 These are
 the nine governing states of honor
 appointed
 in
 the celestial degrees beyond the natural mind
, established
 for
 the ruling
 loves
 of the heav
enly kingdom
, in
 the domin
ion of Divine Truth,
 unto
 et
ernity.

---


**
¶12.** In
 distinction
 from
 these, there
 are nine
 other
 governing states appointed within the natural mind itself
, in the sphere where
 spiritual life
 eng
ages with the world.

**
¶13.** Three governing states are
 established within
 the doctrine that operates in states of spiritual
 illumination:
 one
 belongs
 to the Divine
 mediation, the
 second
 to the Divine
 proceeding as life, the
 third to the Divine active power.


**¶14.** And
 again
, three governing states are established within the
 doctrine that operates in states of spiritual obsc
urity: the
 first belongs to the Divine Wisdom that
 illuminates even
 within
 darkness, the second to the first
 celestial wisdom working
 in obscure
 states
, the third to pure
 truth untouched by falsity.
 These six governing states are established
 within
 the tw
ofold doctrine — one for the
 illuminated mind
, one for the mind
 in
 obscurity —
 because
 the
 Divine provides
 vessels
 of
 order
 for every state
 of the understanding
,
 whether
 it sees
 clearly
 or sees
 dim
ly.

**¶15.
** The seventh governing state is established in
 the highest degree of the rational mind —
 that
 interior
 firm
ament which
 separates celestial perception above
 from
 natural thought below
. The Divine
 Truth
 in its full
 governing power pres
ides there
.

**¶16.**
 The eighth governing state is established in the
 intermediate region between the interior mind
 and the exterior mind
.
 The Divine discernment of
 truth pres
ides there, and it
 judges
 every human spirit
.
 Three spiritual
 destin
ies are distinguished
 before this
 disc
ernment: one path
 leads to spiritual death, which
 is the
 confirmation in
 evil; one path leads to spiritual life
, which is regener
ation; and
 one path leads to the mingling,
 which is the
 intermediate state where good and evil remain
 commingled and are not yet separated
 —
 where
 the person
 is still under
going va
station and has
 not yet been fully
 jud
ged.

*

**¶18.**
 These are
 the nine great
 governing states established within the natural mind
 in
 the sphere
 of engagement
 with the world —
 the arrangements
 of the
 heav
enly kingdom within
 time
 and within
 human
 experience
, through
 which
 the
 Divine gov
erns from
 within
 out
ward,
 hon
oring every
 degree of order
 from
 the in
most love
 to the outermost act
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Eighteen [great thrones for all the fathers] exist and are appointed, which are established in eighteen places! While there are nine among them [appointed in] the outer aeons, they exist [i]n all the worlds of the damage.

The first throne is the throne of the Father, the God of [trut]h, the King of the aeons of greatness, the one who exists; who is established [in his own kingdom,] he alone, in his own essen[c]e, [set] apart. This is the first throne [of all,] the one that surpasses all the thrones.
The second throne is that of the [gl]orious Mother of Life. She is the origin of all the emanations that have come to this world.
The third throne is constructed for the father, the First Man. He is the one who humiliated the entire first enmity, which existed in the worlds of darkness.
The fourth throne is that of the Beloved of the Lights, the great honoured Beloved of the aeons of greatness.

The fifth throne is that of the glorious Great Builder; the great architect who built the new aeon for a newness, for [a habitation] for [the] fathers of light; also for a place of binding and a prison for the enemy and his powers.

[The sixth thro]n[e] is that of the Living Spirit, the [glorious] mighty one, he who bore up the First Man out from the [land of darkness]; who also set in order and constructed the world[s and the firmaments,] both for a cleansing of the light, [and] for a binding [of the] powers of the enmity.
The seventh th[rone is] that of the Third Ambassador, the king of the zone, also the master of all advices.
The eighth throne is that of Jesus the Splendour, who [is] the releaser and redeemer [of] all souls.
The ninth throne is the throne of the great M[ind, he to whom] all the churches shall gather; and all the [life] that will be purified from the world returns to him.

These are the nine thrones of ho[no]u[r] appointed in the outer aeo[ns], <which are established> for the fathers of the glorious realm; [in the kingdom of the King of] Honour, for ever and ever, amen.
In contrast, these are the other nine thrones that are appointed in this world of the zone.
Three thrones in the ship of [the d]ay: one is that of the Ambassador, the second i[s that of] the Great Spirit, the third is that of the Living Spirit.

Once again, there are another three in the ship that [belongs to the night]: the first is the throne of Jesus the Splendour, [the second is that of] the First Man, the third is tha[t of the Virgin of] Light. These six thrones are established in the two ships.
Also, the seventh throne is established in the seventh firmament. The great King of Honour sits upon it.

The eighth throne is established in the atmosphere. The Judge of truth sits upon it, he who judges all mankind. Three paths shall be distinguished before him: one to death, one to life, on[e] to the mingling.

Th[ese] are the [nin]e great [th]ro[nes of honour] that are established in this world of [the zone, the work] of the glorious realm, the one that the [gods and the powers of light] honour them [with glory for ever and ever, amen;] and the [end].
